title: The Vault
logline: Jan tells Michael in confidence that corporate will close either Stamford or Scranton; he tells 'only Dwight', the whole office knows by lunch, and Michael makes a promise he can't keep.
outline: A: Michael swears to keep Jan's secret about a branch closing, tells Dwight, and ends up promising the office nobody will lose their job. B: Jim and Pam play 'Halpert-Beesly Paper', and a lunch talk about what they'd do if Scranton closed gets quiet. C: Dwight forms a Loyalty Task Force with Angela as secretary. Order: cold, A, B, A, C, A, B, A, C, B, A, tag
storySoFar: Jan told Michael that corporate will close either Stamford or Scranton; he told 'only Dwight', and the whole office knew by lunch. In an emergency meeting Michael promised nobody would lose their job, a promise he can't keep; Jan was furious but called him twice. Dwight formed a Loyalty Task Force with Angela as secretary; Creed asked which of his names to sign. Over lunch Jim said Stamford would probably take him if Scranton closed, and Pam went quiet; later she gave him a drawing of the office 'in case it's a museum', and he kept it. Roy would move Pam to Allentown. Earlier: Pam kissed Jim on the cheek at the Dundies and doesn't remember; Angela secretly gave Dwight a homemade Dundie; Ryan the temp is in business school; Kelly calls him Ry-Ry.

scenes.recap: Jim answers every one of Dwight's questions with a question until Dwight snaps.

beats.text: Jim, did you take my stapler?
Why would I take your stapler?
Is that a no?
Does it sound like a no?
Answer the question!
Which question?
Dwight, do you want your messages?
Do I— DON'T YOU START.

scenes.recap: Jan tells Michael by phone that corporate will close Stamford or Scranton, and that he can't tell anyone.

beats.caption: answers the phone, sitting up very straight

beats.text: Jan! Hi. Yes. I'm alone. I'm always alone. Not like that.
Close a branch? Us or Stamford? No, I understand. Total secrecy. I'm a vault, Jan.

lines: People think I can't keep a secret. I can. I'm a vault.
I'm a vault that's very, very full right now. A vault with a lot of pressure on it.

scenes.recap: Jim and Pam play 'Halpert-Beesly Paper': he interviews her for a job at their imaginary company.

beats.text: Miss Beesly. Thanks for coming in. Halpert-Beesly Paper is very selective.
Thank you, Mr. Halpert. I see my name is already on the company.
Benefits include a desk by the window and no Dwight. Ever.
I'll take it. When do I start?
You already work here. You're the vice president.

lines: Halpert-Beesly Paper has a very generous vacation policy. And a ball pit.
It's not real. I know it's not real.

scenes.recap: Michael lasts eleven minutes before telling Dwight, 'and only Dwight'.

beats.text: Dwight. Can you keep a secret? A real one. Not a farm one.
I have kept secrets for three generations. Some of them aren't even mine.
Corporate is closing a branch. Us or Stamford. Nobody can know. Only you.
Michael. I will take this to my grave. Which I have already dug. It's on the farm.

lines: Telling Dwight doesn't count. Dwight is like a diary. With glasses.
Eleven minutes. That's a personal best.

scenes.recap: Dwight founds the Loyalty Task Force and appoints Angela secretary, without saying why.

beats.text: Angela. I'm forming a Loyalty Task Force. I need a secretary. Someone ruthless.
I accept.
Loyal to what?
To this branch. Which is in no danger whatsoever. Of closing. Which is not happening.
We're closing?

scenes.recap: Michael discovers the whole office knows, by way of a game of telephone.

beats.text: Michael, is it true we're merging with Stamford and everyone's getting fired except Dwight?
Who told you that?
Phyllis told me, and Kevin told Phyllis, and Kevin heard it from Dwight's face.
I also heard we're all moving to Connecticut. I don't want to live in Connecticut, Michael.
I'm not moving to Connecticut.
Nobody is moving to Connecticut! Conference room. Five minutes. Everybody.

scenes.recap: Over lunch, Jim and Pam talk about what they'd do if Scranton closed; Jim says Stamford would probably take him, and Pam goes quiet.

beats.text: If we close, Roy says we'd move to his cousin's in Allentown. He'd drive a forklift there.
That sounds... like a lot of forklift.
What would you do?
I don't know. Stamford would probably take me.
Oh. Yeah. That makes sense.

lines: I wasn't going to say Stamford. It just came out.
It's probably nothing. We're probably not closing. It's probably nothing.

scenes.recap: Michael's emergency meeting spirals, and he promises nobody will lose their job.

beats.text: There is no rumor. And if there were, it would be about Stamford. Who stinks.
Is Stamford more profitable than us?
Define 'profitable.' Define 'us.'
This is actually a fascinating case study.
Okay. Listen. Nobody in this room is going to lose their job. I promise you that.
Can you promise that?
Yes.

scenes.recap: The Loyalty Task Force administers its oath; Creed asks which of his names to sign, and Ryan asks for a copy for school.

beats.text: Creed Bratton. Sign the Oath of Loyalty to the Scranton branch.
Which name do you want? I've got four that are clean.
The one on your paycheck.
Huh. Which one is on my paycheck?
Can I get a copy of the oath? For my organizational behavior class.
Copies are how spies are made. Sign.

scenes.recap: Pam gives Jim a little drawing of the office 'in case it's a museum someday'; Jim keeps it.

beats.caption: slides a small pencil drawing of the bullpen across the desk

beats.text: In case we close. Then it's a museum. That's you, and that's Dwight's beet.
This is really good, Pam.
It's just a doodle.
It's a really good doodle. Can I keep it?

lines: It's going on my fridge. No. It's going in a drawer. A safe drawer.
Okay, it's going on my fridge.

scenes.recap: Jan calls back, furious that the secret is out; Michael is honest about the promise he made.

beats.caption: picks up the phone like it might bite

beats.text: Jan. I did not tell anyone. I told one person. Who told everyone. Technically I'm innocent.
I know I can't promise them that. But they needed to hear it, Jan. From someone.

lines: Jan said I'm the worst regional manager she's ever had to call twice in one day.
But she called twice. Think about that.

scenes.recap: Toby asks to join the Loyalty Task Force; Dwight declines with a form.

beats.text: Dwight, I'd like to sign the loyalty oath. I really like it here.

beats.caption: hands Toby a form titled REJECTION

beats.text: HR is the eyes of corporate. You are a spy by definition. Fill this out in triplicate.
Toby, you can be in my loyalty club. It's just me and a candle.
